Requirements:
- Java 21, Spring Boot 3.3.5, Maven pom.xml
- Package: com.support.tickets
- Entities: Ticket, Comment, TicketStatus (OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, CLOSED, CANCELLED), Priority (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, URGENT)
- TicketStateMachine with transitions per state-machine.md
- REST: POST/GET/PUT /api/tickets, GET /api/tickets/{id}, PUT /api/tickets/{id}/status, POST /api/tickets/{id}/comments
- Query params: status, q for search
- Jakarta validation, ProblemDetail error responses, 409 on invalid transitions
- CORS for localhost:5173 and 3000
- H2 file: jdbc:h2:file:./data/tickets
- Tests: TicketStateMachineTest (4 tests), TicketStateMachineIntegrationTest, TicketControllerIntegrationTest
- test application.properties with H2 mem
- README.md and .gitignore (target/, data/)

Write ALL files. Do not skip tests. Return list of files created.

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Beginning to generate the complete Spring Boot application. Starting with the Maven POM, main application class, H2 file properties, and test configuration.

Mapping out the remaining files. Domain includes enums, entities, repositories, and service classes. Web layer covers controllers, DTOs, exception handling, and CORS. Tests include state machine and controller integration suites.

Designing REST API response structures. POST creates return 201 with full ticket payloads. PUT updates return the modified ticket. Status updates return the ticket with the new status. Comments return 201 with the ticket or standalone comment response. Error responses will use ProblemDetail format with field errors.

Defining the exact state machine transitions. OPEN moves to IN_PROGRESS or CANCELLED. IN_PROGRESS moves to RESOLVED or CANCELLED. RESOLVED moves to CLOSED. CLOSED and CANCELLED are terminal states. Same-status updates are no-ops.

Planning four state machine unit tests. Valid OPEN transitions. A happy path through IN_PROGRESS and RESOLVED to CLOSED. Invalid transitions returning exceptions. Same-status no-ops.

Designing three integration tests. A happy path status change. An illegal CLOSED-to-OPEN transition returning 409. A cancel-from-open scenario.

Expanding the test plan to nine cases total. New scenarios cover blank title validation, search queries, status filtering, and comment threads. The package structure is now fully defined under `com.support.tickets` with separate packages for domain, repository, service, web, DTOs, and exceptions.

Drafting the JPQL filter query for status and text search across titles and descriptions. Outlining the Ticket entity fields with JPA annotations, default OPEN status, and cascading comments. Using @PrePersist and @PreUpdate for automatic timestamp generation.

Decided to implement a custom `ValidationErrorResponse` class instead of pure `ProblemDetail`. The response will include `fieldErrors` as specified in the API contract. It will carry a standard HTTP error body with timestamp, status, error, message, and path.

Finalizing the error response shapes. Validation failures will carry `fieldErrors` inside the custom error body. 409 transitions will return `Invalid Status Transition`. The global exception handler will be a `@RestControllerAdvice` bean. CORS will allow localhost:5173 and 
</details></think>

## Highlights

- **State machine** — transitions per `state-machine.md`; same-status no-op allowed; invalid transitions throw `InvalidStatusTransitionException` → HTTP 409 with `error: "Invalid Status Transition"`
- **REST API** — all endpoints under `/api/tickets` with `status` and `q` query params
- **Validation** — Jakarta validation; 400 responses include `fieldErrors` map
- **CORS** — `http://localhost:5173` and `http://localhost:3000`
- **H2** — file store `jdbc:h2:file:./data/tickets` (main); in-memory for tests
- **Status changes** — only via `PUT /api/tickets/{id}/status`, not generic PUT

Run locally:

```bash
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64
cd support-ticket-service && mvn spring-boot:run
```
